entities.name: Kongming
entities.description: Shu strategist known as Sleeping Dragon.

entities.name: Liu Bei
entities.description: Lord of Shu and sworn brother of Guan Yu and Zhang Fei.

entities.name: Guan Yu
entities.description: Shu general and oath-brother, wielder of the Green Dragon blade.

entities.name: Zhang Fei
entities.description: Fierce Shu warrior of Yan.

entities.name: Zhao Zilong
entities.description: Tiger General who twice rescued Liu Shan.

entities.name: Ma Chao
entities.description: General who surrendered to Liu Bei and became a Tiger General.

entities.name: Ma Su
entities.description: Arrogant Shu general who lost Jieting.

entities.name: Pang Tong
entities.description: Young Phoenix whose boat-connecting scheme helped Zhou Yu.

entities.name: Huang Zhong
entities.description: Shu General.

entities.name: Sun Quan

entities.name: Zhou Yu
entities.description: Wu chief commander who died crying out about Kongming.

entities.name: Lu Su
entities.description: Wu advisor who became supreme commander after Zhou Yu.

entities.name: Lu Meng
entities.description: Wu general who conquered Jingzhou in 219.

entities.name: Gan Ning
entities.description: Wu general who raided Cao Cao's camp.

entities.name: Zhuge Jin
entities.description: Wu strategist who proposed a marriage alliance.

entities.name: Lady Sun
entities.description: Sister of Sun Quan and wife of Liu Bei.

entities.name: Cao Cao
entities.description: Wei prime minister who exploits the emperor and fights at Red Cliffs.

entities.name: Cao Ren
entities.description: Cao Cao's cousin and fierce commander.

entities.name: Sima Yi
entities.description: Wei field marshal who served four generations of Cao.

entities.name: Xun Yu
entities.description: Wei advisor.

entities.name: Zhang Liao
entities.description: Wei general who won Hefei.

entities.name: Emperor Xian
entities.description: Emperor who issued a blood edict against Cao Cao.

entities.name: Yuan Shao

entities.name: Dong Zhuo
entities.description: Warlord whose man was Lu Bu.

entities.name: Xiahou Dun
entities.description: Valiant general who swallowed his eye and fought on.

entities.name: Zhang Jue

entities.name: Meng Huo

entities.name: Zuo Ci
entities.description: Taoist mystic who appears in distant places at once.

entities.name: Jiang Wei
entities.description: General who fought the north nine times.

entities.name: Yellow Scarves
entities.description: Rebels led by Zhang Jue.

entities.name: Shu
entities.description: Kingdom founded by Liu Bei.

entities.name: Wu
entities.description: Southern kingdom ruled by Sun Quan.

entities.name: Wei
entities.description: Northern kingdom ruled by the Cao family.

entities.name: Red Cliffs
entities.description: Battle of 208 where Cao Cao was defeated by fire.

entities.name: Peach Garden Oath
entities.description: Oath of brotherhood among Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei.

entities.name: Jingzhou
entities.description: Province coveted by Wu, Shu and Wei.

events.summary: Kongming bluffs an army of 150,000 Wei at Xicheng by leaving gates open and playing a zither.
events.quote: He tricked an army of 150,000 Wei by leaving the city gates open and calmly playing the zither.

events.summary: Zhang Fei bellows a challenge at Steepslope Bridge and Cao Cao's army flees.
events.quote: Cao Cao's army cowered and fled.

events.summary: Ma Su loses the city of Jieting, ruining Kongming's first campaign.
events.quote: an arrogant Shu general, Ma Su, foolishly lost the city of Jieting.

events.summary: Liu Bei vows revenge on the death of his oath-brother Guan Yu.
events.quote: Until I've gnawed their flesh and exterminated their clans, my humiliation will not be effaced.

events.summary: After the Peach Garden Oath the three brothers raise an army of 500 youths against the Yellow Scarves.
events.quote: the three brothers raised an army of 500 youths to fight the Yellow Scarves rebellion.

events.summary: Zhao Zilong twice rescues Liu Bei's son Liu Shan.
events.quote: Twice he rescued Liu Bei's son, Liu Shan.

events.summary: Kongming and Lu Su trick Wei troops into shooting 100,000 arrows.
events.quote: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them

events.summary: At Red Cliffs Kongming and Zhou Yu both write 'Fire' on their palms.
events.quote: They laughed as they both revealed the same word, "Fire."

events.summary: Zhou Yu plants a forged letter that a Wei advisor steals.
events.quote: allowed his old friend, a Wei advisor, to steal a planted letter forged as if from Wei's two best admirals.

events.summary: Cao Cao escapes Red Cliffs with only 27 of his 800,000 men.
events.quote: Cao Cao escaped from the battle of Red Cliffs with only 27 of his original 800,000 men.

events.summary: Lu Meng conquers Shu-held Jingzhou by disguising soldiers as merchants.
events.quote: Lu Meng conquered Shu-held Jingzhou in 219 by disguising soldiers as merchants

events.summary: Gan Ning raids Cao Cao's camp with 100 cavalry without losses.
events.quote: Gan Ning raided Cao Cao's camp of 400,000 men with only 100 cavalry.

events.summary: Cao Ren tricks Zhou Yu into Nanjun and rains arrows upon him.
events.quote: Cao Ren tricked Zhou Yu by letting him enter Nanjun.

events.summary: Zhou Yu cries to heaven on his deathbed about Kongming.
events.quote: After making me, Zhou Yu, did you have to make Kongming?

events.summary: Guan Yu's arrogant refusal of a marriage proposal from Zhuge Jin leads to disaster.
events.quote: Guan Yu's arrogant refusal led to disaster.

events.summary: Cao Cao uses the emperor's name to exert his own influence.
events.quote: Cao Cao used the emperor's name to exert his own influence on the empire.

events.summary: Cao Cao executes his two best admirals for treason after the forged letter.
events.quote: Cao Cao rashly executed his two best admirals for treason.

events.summary: Cao Cao is haunted to death by ghosts of those he murdered.
events.quote: Cao Cao was haunted to death by the ghosts of the empresses and other high courtiers he had murdered.

events.summary: Emperor Xian issues a secret edict in his own blood condemning Cao Cao.
events.quote: Emperor Xian secretly issued an edict condemning him, using his own blood as ink.

events.summary: Cao Cao defeats Yuan Shao at Guandu by raiding his grain depot.
events.quote: Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao by raiding his grain depot

events.summary: Lu Bu loses Puyang and later his life to Cao Cao.
events.quote: He lost the city—and later his life—to Cao Cao.

events.summary: Zhang Liao defeats Sun Quan at Hefei.
events.quote: Zhang Liao defeated Sun Quan

events.summary: Ma Chao defeats two of Cao Cao's generals but must flee after trickery turns his ally against him.
events.quote: Ma Chao defeated the two generals Cao Cao sent to guard the pass

events.summary: Kongming captures and releases Meng Huo seven times before he surrenders.
events.quote: The stubborn Meng Huo was captured and released by Kongming seven times before finally surrendering.

events.summary: Lady Zhurong scolds her husband and vows to fight for him.
events.quote: I, a woman, will fight them for you.

events.summary: The three oath-brothers swear to die on the same day.
events.quote: hereby vow to die the selfsame day.

events.summary: Liu Bei fights Ma Chao at Chengdu and Ma Chao surrenders.
events.quote: Eventually, Ma Chao surrendered and became one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.

events.summary: Zhang Jue leads the Yellow Scarves rebellion.
events.quote: Zhang Jue, leader of the Yellow Scarves rebellion, was a Taoist master
